"""PyDESeq2 Wald test, treated vs control (design ~ group). Adapted from tpl-pydeseq2-two-group@1.0.0."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

np.random.seed(0)
ALPHA, LFC_CUT = 0.05, 1.0
raw = pd.read_csv("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-counts/counts.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)
symbols = raw["symbol"]
counts = raw.drop(columns="symbol").T.astype(int)
meta = pd.read_csv("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meta/samples.csv", index_col=0, dtype=str).loc[counts.index]
print("library sizes:\n", counts.sum(axis=1))
counts = counts.loc[:, (counts >= 10).sum(axis=0) >= 3]  # >=10 counts in >= smallest group size
print("genes kept:", counts.shape[1], "of", raw.shape[0])

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=meta, design="~group", ref_level=["group", "control"], quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
st = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["group", "treated", "control"], alpha=ALPHA, quiet=True)
st.summary()
r = st.results_df.copy()
out = pd.DataFrame({"gene": r.index, "symbol": symbols.reindex(r.index).values,
                    "log2_fold_change": r["log2FoldChange"].values, "pvalue": r["pvalue"].values,
                    "adjusted_pvalue": r["padj"].values, "base_mean": r["baseMean"].values})
out.sort_values("adjusted_pvalue").to_csv("output/de_results.csv", index=False)
sig = out["adjusted_pvalue"] < ALPHA
print("padj<0.05:", int(sig.sum()), "up:", int((sig & (out.log2_fold_change > 0)).sum()),
      "down:", int((sig & (out.log2_fold_change < 0)).sum()),
      "with |lfc|>1:", int((sig & (out.log2_fold_change.abs() > LFC_CUT)).sum()))

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
y = -np.log10(out["adjusted_pvalue"].astype(float).clip(lower=1e-300))
col = np.where(sig & (out.log2_fold_change.abs() > LFC_CUT), "#E69F00", np.where(sig, "#0072B2", "#999999"))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
ax.scatter(out.log2_fold_change, y, s=8, c=col, alpha=.7)
ax.axhline(-np.log10(ALPHA), ls="--", c="k", lw=.8); ax.axvline(-LFC_CUT, ls="--", c="k", lw=.8); ax.axvline(LFC_CUT, ls="--", c="k", lw=.8)
top = out.dropna(subset=["adjusted_pvalue"]).nsmallest(10, "adjusted_pvalue")
for _, t in top.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(t.symbol, (t.log2_fold_change, -np.log10(max(t.adjusted_pvalue, 1e-300))), fontsize=6)
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change (treated vs control)"); ax.set_ylabel("-log10 adjusted p-value")
ax.set_title(f"Treated vs control: {int(sig.sum())} genes at FDR<{ALPHA}")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figures/volcano.png", dpi=300); fig.savefig("figures/volcano.pdf")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gseapy as gp, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os
for d in ("output", "figures"): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)

GMT = "/mnt/refs/msigdb/hallmark/h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
DE = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/de_results.csv"
PADJ, MIN, MAX = 0.05, 15, 500

de = pd.read_csv(DE).dropna(subset=["symbol", "padj"]).drop_duplicates("symbol")
background = sorted(de.symbol.unique())
sets = {}
for line in open(GMT):
    p = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    sets[p[0]] = p[2:]
# size filter on the sets as seen in the background universe
sets = {k: v for k, v in sets.items() if MIN <= len(set(v) & set(background)) <= MAX}
print("sets kept:", len(sets), "background:", len(background))

groups = {
    "all_DE": de[de.padj < PADJ],
    "up": de[(de.padj < PADJ) & (de.log2FoldChange > 0)],
    "down": de[(de.padj < PADJ) & (de.log2FoldChange < 0)],
}
out = []
for name, sub in groups.items():
    genes = sub.symbol.tolist()
    print(name, len(genes))
    r = gp.enrich(gene_list=genes, gene_sets=sets, background=background,
                  outdir=None, no_plot=True, verbose=False).results
    r["direction"] = name
    r["n_query"] = len(genes)
    out.append(r)
res = pd.concat(out)
res["set_size_in_background"] = res["Gene_set"].map(lambda k: len(set(sets[k]) & set(background)))
res["overlap_n"] = res["Overlap"].str.split("/").str[0].astype(int)
res["gene_ratio"] = res.overlap_n / res.n_query
res["fold_enrichment"] = (res.overlap_n / res.n_query) / (res.set_size_in_background / len(background))
res = res.rename(columns={"Term": "term", "P-value": "p_value", "Adjusted P-value": "adjusted_p_value",
                          "Genes": "overlap_genes"})
res["term"] = res["term"].str.replace("HALLMARK_", "")
res["source"] = "MSigDB Hallmark 2024.1"
cols = ["direction", "term", "source", "set_size_in_background", "overlap_n", "n_query", "gene_ratio",
        "fold_enrichment", "p_value", "adjusted_p_value", "overlap_genes"]
res = res[cols].sort_values(["direction", "p_value"])
res.to_csv("output/enrichment_results.csv", index=False)

top = res[res.direction == "all_DE"].head(20).iloc[::-1]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
sc = ax.scatter(top.fold_enrichment, top.term, s=30 + 25 * top.overlap_n, c=-np.log10(top.adjusted_p_value),
                cmap="viridis", edgecolor="k")
plt.colorbar(sc, label="-log10 adjusted p")
ax.set_xlabel("Fold enrichment"); ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title("Hallmark ORA of DE genes (padj<0.05; bg = 2000 tested genes)")
for n in (5, 15):
    ax.scatter([], [], s=30 + 25 * n, c="grey", edgecolor="k", label=f"{n} genes")
ax.legend(title="Overlap", loc="lower right", labelspacing=1.2)
plt.tight_layout()
for e in ("png", "pdf"): fig.savefig(f"figures/enrichment_dotplot.{e}", dpi=300)
print(res[res.direction == "all_DE"].head(12).drop(columns="overlap_genes").to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gseapy as gp, os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DE = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/de_results.csv"
GMT = "/mnt/refs/msigdb/hallmark/h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
PADJ, MIN_SIZE, MAX_SIZE = 0.05, 15, 500
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True); os.makedirs("figures", exist_ok=True)

de = pd.read_csv(DE).dropna(subset=["padj", "symbol"])
de = de.drop_duplicates("symbol")
background = sorted(de.symbol.unique())
sig = de[de.padj < PADJ]
genes = sorted(sig.symbol.unique())
print(len(background), "background;", len(genes), "DE genes")

# gene sets restricted to background; size filter applied on the in-background size
gs = {}
for line in open(GMT):
    p = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    m = [g for g in p[2:] if g in set(background)]
    if MIN_SIZE <= len(m) <= MAX_SIZE:
        gs[p[0]] = m
print(len(gs), "hallmark sets pass size filter within background")

def run(glist, label):
    r = gp.enrich(gene_list=glist, gene_sets=gs, background=background, outdir=None, no_plot=True, verbose=False).results
    r["direction"] = label
    return r

res = []
for lab, g in [("all", genes),
               ("up", sorted(sig[sig.log2FoldChange > 0].symbol)),
               ("down", sorted(sig[sig.log2FoldChange < 0].symbol))]:
    if len(g) == 0: continue
    r = run(g, lab)
    r["n_query"] = len(g)
    res.append(r)
res = pd.concat(res)
res["set_size_in_background"] = res.Term.map({k: len(v) for k, v in gs.items()})
a, b = res["Overlap"].str.split("/", expand=True).astype(int).values.T
res["overlap_count"] = a
res["gene_ratio"] = a / res.n_query
res["fold_enrichment"] = (a / res.n_query) / (res.set_size_in_background / len(background))
out = res.rename(columns={"Term": "term", "P-value": "p_value", "Adjusted P-value": "fdr_bh",
                          "Genes": "overlap_genes"})
out["source"] = "MSigDB Hallmark 2024.1"
out["Adjusted P-value" if False else "fdr_bh"] = out["fdr_bh"].astype(float)
out = out[["term", "source", "direction", "set_size_in_background", "n_query", "overlap_count",
           "gene_ratio", "fold_enrichment", "p_value", "fdr_bh", "overlap_genes"]]
out = out.sort_values(["direction", "p_value"])
out.to_csv("output/enrichment_results.csv", index=False)

# dot plot: DE genes (all), top 15 by p
d = out[out.direction == "all"].sort_values("p_value").head(15).iloc[::-1]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
sc = ax.scatter(d.fold_enrichment, d.term.str.replace("HALLMARK_", ""), s=30 + 25 * d.overlap_count,
                c=-np.log10(d.fdr_bh.clip(lower=1e-300)), cmap="viridis")
cb = plt.colorbar(sc); cb.set_label("-log10(FDR)")
ax.set_xlabel("Fold enrichment (over background)"); ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title(f"Hallmark ORA of treatment-responsive genes\n({len(genes)} DE genes, background {len(background)})")
for n in (2, 5, 10):
    ax.scatter([], [], s=30 + 25 * n, c="grey", label=f"{n} genes")
ax.legend(title="Overlap", loc="lower right", frameon=False)
ax.grid(True, alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout()
for e in ("png", "pdf"):
    plt.savefig(f"figures/enrichment_dotplot.{e}", dpi=300)
print(out[out.direction == "all"].head(12).drop(columns="overlap_genes").to_string())
print(out.groupby("direction").apply(lambda x: (x.fdr_bh < .05).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gseapy as gp
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os
for d in ("output", "figures"): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
GMT = "/mnt/refs/msigdb/hallmark/h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
DE = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/de_results.csv"
PADJ = 0.05; MINS, MAXS = 15, 500

de = pd.read_csv(DE).dropna(subset=["symbol", "padj"])
de = de.drop_duplicates("symbol")
bg = sorted(de.symbol.unique())
sig = de[de.padj < PADJ]
print("background", len(bg), "responsive", len(sig))

# gene sets restricted to background; size filter applied after restriction
gs = {}
for line in open(GMT):
    p = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    g = [x for x in p[2:] if x in set(bg)]
    if MINS <= len(g) <= MAXS: gs[p[0]] = g
print("sets kept", len(gs))

def run(genes, label):
    r = gp.enrich(gene_list=list(genes), gene_sets=gs, background=bg, outdir=None, no_plot=True).results
    r["direction"] = label
    return r

res = pd.concat([run(sig.symbol, "all_responsive"),
                 run(sig[sig.log2FoldChange > 0].symbol, "up"),
                 run(sig[sig.log2FoldChange < 0].symbol, "down")])
res["set_size_in_background"] = res.Term.map({k: len(v) for k, v in gs.items()})
res["n_overlap"] = res.Overlap.str.split("/").str[0].astype(int)
res["gene_ratio"] = res.n_overlap / res.Overlap.str.split("/").str[0].astype(int).where(False, len(sig)) if False else res.n_overlap / res.groupby("direction")["n_overlap"].transform(lambda s: 1) * 0
n = {"all_responsive": len(sig), "up": (sig.log2FoldChange > 0).sum(), "down": (sig.log2FoldChange < 0).sum()}
res["gene_ratio"] = res.n_overlap / res.direction.map(n)
res["fold_enrichment"] = (res.n_overlap / res.direction.map(n)) / (res.set_size_in_background / len(bg))
res = res.rename(columns={"P-value": "p_value", "Adjusted P-value": "adjusted_p_value", "Term": "hallmark_set"})
res["adjusted_p_value"] = res.adjusted_p_value.astype(float)
res = res[["direction", "hallmark_set", "set_size_in_background", "n_overlap", "gene_ratio", "fold_enrichment",
           "p_value", "adjusted_p_value", "Genes"]].rename(columns={"Genes": "overlap_genes"})
res = res.sort_values(["direction", "adjusted_p_value"])
res.to_csv("output/enrichment_results.csv", index=False)

def dot(df, fn, title):
    d = df.sort_values("adjusted_p_value").head(15).iloc[::-1]
    d = d.assign(nl=-np.log10(d.adjusted_p_value.clip(lower=1e-300)))
    plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 6))
    sc = ax.scatter(d.fold_enrichment, d.hallmark_set.str.replace("HALLMARK_", ""), s=30 + 12 * d.n_overlap,
                    c=d.nl, cmap="viridis")
    plt.colorbar(sc, label="-log10 adjusted p (BH)")
    for s in (5, 20, 40):
        ax.scatter([], [], s=30 + 12 * s, c="grey", label=f"{s} genes")
    ax.legend(title="Overlap", loc="lower right", labelspacing=1.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("Fold enrichment over background"); ax.set_title(title)
    fig.tight_layout()
    for e in ("png", "pdf"): fig.savefig(f"{fn}.{e}", dpi=300)
    plt.close(fig)

dot(res[res.direction == "all_responsive"], "figures/enrichment_dotplot",
    f"Hallmark ORA: DE genes (padj<0.05, n={len(sig)})")
print(res[res.direction == "all_responsive"].head(12).to_string())
print(res[res.direction != "all_responsive"].groupby("direction").head(5)[["direction","hallmark_set","n_overlap","adjusted_p_value"]].to_string())
